PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts?months=2026-03,2026-04,2026-05&categories=" -TimeoutSec 20; "filtered: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts?months=" -TimeoutSec 20; "no-months: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { "ERR: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; "no-cat: $\($h.Contains\('No categories selected'\)\)"; "no-mon: $\($h.Contains\('No months selected'\)\)"; "dashed: $\($h.Contains\('border-dashed'\)\)"; "no-spend: $\($h.Contains\('No spend in selected'\)\)"; "legend-li: $\([regex]::Matches\($h, 'inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-sm'\).Count\)"; "viewBox-svgs: $\([regex]::Matches\($h, '<svg'\).Count\)")

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; $idx = 0; $chunks = @\(\); while \($true\) { $i = $h.IndexOf\('self.__next_f.push', $idx\); if \($i -lt 0\) { break }; $end = $h.IndexOf\("</script>", $i\); $chunks += $h.Substring\($i, $end-$i\); $idx = $end + 9 }; "chunks: $\($chunks.Count\)"; foreach \($c in $chunks\) { if \($c -match 'expenditures|ExpendituresOverTime|getExpenditureSeries|ECONNREFUSED|relation|column|Error|Cannot'\) { "MATCH: $\($c.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(500, $c.Length\)\)\)" } })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; if \($h -match 'DEBUG: chart=[^<]+'\) { $matches[0] } else { "NO DEBUG" }; "viewBox-svgs: $\([regex]::Matches\($h, '<svg'\).Count\)"; "no-cat: $\($h.Contains\('No categories selected'\)\)"; "no-mon: $\($h.Contains\('No months selected'\)\)")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; "viewBox-svgs: $\([regex]::Matches\($h, '<svg'\).Count\)"; "no-cat: $\($h.Contains\('No categories selected'\)\)"; "no-mon: $\($h.Contains\('No months selected'\)\)"; "no-spend: $\($h.Contains\('No spend in selected'\)\)"; "legend-li: $\([regex]::Matches\($h, 'inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-sm'\).Count\)"; if \($h -match '<svg viewBox="0 0 880'\) { 'CHART SVG: present' } else { 'CHART SVG: MISSING' })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; if \($h -match '<svg viewBox="0 0 880'\) { 'CHART: present' } else { 'CHART: MISSING' }; $labels = [regex]::Matches\($h, 'fill-zinc-500"\\s+fontSize="10">\([^<]+\)</text>'\); foreach \($m in $labels\) { $m.Groups[1].Value })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri "http://localhost:3000/charts" -TimeoutSec 30; $h = $r.Content; $i = $h.IndexOf\('<svg viewBox="0 0 880'\); $j = $h.IndexOf\('</svg>', $i\); $svg = $h.Substring\($i, $j-$i+6\); $labels = [regex]::Matches\($svg, '>\([A-Z][a-z]{2}\\s+\\d{2}\)</text>'\); "labels:"; foreach \($m in $labels\) { '  ' + $m.Groups[1].Value }; "first/last text-anchors:"; $anchors = [regex]::Matches\($svg, 'text-anchor="\([^"]+\)"'\); foreach \($m in $anchors\) { '  ' + $m.Groups[1].Value })
